$comment: Web Bot Auth verification (agentcake/detect/webbotauth.py): what a signature must carry, how far its times may be from this computer's clock, which keys are never trusted, what one verification may cost, and the text of each reason. Protocol: draft-ietf-webbotauth-httpsig-protocol-01 over RFC 9421. Each setting is described in $doc.

$doc.tag: The tag parameter that marks a Web Bot Auth signature (draft -01 section 5.2). Signatures with another tag are not looked at.
$doc.algorithms: alg parameter values Agent Cake verifies. Only Ed25519 is implemented; another alg gives declared, unsupported-algorithm.
$doc.required_parameters: Signature parameters a Web Bot Auth signature must have (draft -01 section 5.2). Without one: declared, incomplete.
$doc.required_components_any: The signature must cover at least one of these (draft -01 section 5.2). Otherwise: declared, incomplete.
$doc.signature_agent_schemes: URL schemes accepted in Signature-Agent (draft -01 section 5.2.1 requires https).
$doc.directory_well_known_path: Path of a signer's key directory on its origin (draft -01 section 8.1). A Signature-Agent URL with this path, or none, names the host.
$doc.clock_skew_s: Seconds the signer's clock and this computer's may disagree, in both directions: a signature created up to this far in the future, or expired up to this long ago, still counts as inside its window. Outside it the result is declared, never invalid.
$doc.max_age_s: A signature older than this (from created) is declared, too-old, even when its expires is later. 86400 s follows draft -01 section 5.2 (expires no more than 24 hours after created).
$doc.max_signatures: At most this many Web Bot Auth signatures of one request are checked; each costs one Ed25519 verification.
$doc.rejected_key_thumbprints: Keys never trusted, by JWK thumbprint, with why. Published test keys must not be accepted in production (draft -01 section 6.8). A signature with one of them is declared, test-key.
$doc.verify_budget_ms: Most a single verification may take in pure Python (under 50 ms); tests measure the median of 100.
$doc.session_cache_size: Sessions whose verification result SessionVerifier keeps (least recently used are dropped first).
$doc.reasons: Text for each reason code; {signer}, {keyid}, {label}, {claimed} and the facts of the check are filled in. $missing stands in for a value that is not known.
$doc.details: The technical words of each reason code (what was checked), shown under its reason; the same facts fill them in.

reasons.verified-by-key: Verified: signed with a key that {signer} publishes.
reasons.bad-signature: The signature check failed: the signed parts of the request changed, or the signature is forged.
reasons.unsupported-algorithm: The name is self-reported because this signature type isn't checked here.
reasons.unsupported-key: The signing key can't be checked here, so the name is self-reported.
reasons.incomplete: The signature is incomplete, so the name is self-reported.
reasons.unknown-signer: This release doesn't have the signer's keys, so the name is self-reported.
reasons.key-missing: The signing key isn't one this release has, so the name is self-reported.
reasons.key-shared: Several signers publish the signing key, so the name is self-reported.
reasons.test-key: The signing key isn't accepted, so the name is self-reported.
reasons.key-not-yet-valid: The signing key wasn't valid yet, so the name is self-reported.
reasons.key-expired: The signing key had expired, so the name is self-reported.
reasons.not-yet-valid: The signature is dated in the future, so the name is self-reported.
reasons.expired: The signature has expired, so the name is self-reported.
reasons.too-old: The signature is too old, so the name is self-reported.
reasons.no-signature-value: The signature is missing, so the name is self-reported.
reasons.unrebuildable: The signature can't be checked against this request, so the name is self-reported.
reasons.claim-only: The request names a signer but has no signature to verify, so the name is self-reported.

details.verified: Web Bot Auth signature verified with {signer}'s key {keyid}.
details.verified-by-key: Web Bot Auth signature verified with key {keyid}; the request doesn't name its signer in a signed Signature-Agent.
details.bad-signature: The Web Bot Auth signature of {signer}, with key {keyid}, doesn't verify.
details.unsupported-algorithm: The signature uses {alg}, which isn't verified here.
details.unsupported-key: Key {keyid} of {signer} isn't an Ed25519 key, the only kind verified here.
details.incomplete: It lacks {missing}, which Web Bot Auth requires.
details.unknown-signer: {signer} isn't among the signers whose keys come with this release.
details.key-missing: Key {keyid} isn't among the keys of {signer} that come with this release; it may be newer.
details.key-not-yet-valid: Key {keyid} of {signer} wasn't yet valid when the signature was made.
details.key-expired: Key {keyid} of {signer} had expired when the signature was made.
details.not-yet-valid: It was made {seconds} s in the future by this computer's clock.
details.too-old: It was made {seconds} s ago, more than the {max_age_s} s allowed.
details.no-signature-value: Signature-Input names signature {label}, but the Signature field has no value for it.
details.unrebuildable: What {signer} signed can't be rebuilt from this request: {detail}.
details.claim-only: Signature-Agent names {claimed}, but the request carries no Web Bot Auth signature.
